profile.headline: Software Engineer at General Dynamics Mission Systems
profile.summary: Computer Science graduate from the University of Nevada-Las Vegas, driven by a passion for problem-solving and technology. Currently honing my skills in Technical Support, Information Technology, and Software Development. I am compelled by collaboration with talented individuals and am eager to contribute to impactful projects. Excited to continue to explore new opportunities and continue my growth in the dynamic field of technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
Lead project consultations with clients to accurately identify their needs and requirements.
Develop, debug, and test scripts and projects to meet company and customer objectives.
Document all communication and support activities in tickets through Zendesk.
Research, diagnose, and troubleshoot technical issues related to PLCs, HMIs, and other items.
Compile technical knowledge for manuals, articles, notes, and training.
Travel to trade shows and client sites for project design, troubleshooting, and communication.
positions.insights: Network Troubleshooting, Human Machine Interface and +7 skills

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Implement network protocols from frame structure and command documentation.
Develop utilizing GitLab and Git workflow, and create merge requests for collaborative review and implementation.

positions.title: Information Technology Technician
positions.description:
Assist End-Users with troubleshooting issues using excellent Customer Service.
Contact Vendors to troubleshoot, install software, and replace hardware.
Manage User accounts and permissions in software and Active Directory.
Configure software to be usable and compliant with company policies.
Install hardware and ensure functionality.
positions.insights: Information Security, Active Directory and +24 skills

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Took part in over 125+ hours of community service
• Assisted organization with numerous events such as fundraisers, runs, clean-ups, food banks, etc.
